adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` the CalDAV/iCal event creation filters target calendars using only the first element of `event.destinationCalendar` (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then `.filter(c => mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId ? c.externalId === mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId : true)`). With the diff, `destinationCalendar` is now an array to support collective/team hosts, and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` can call `createEvent` for multiple credentials/hosts. For any non-first host whose calendar externalId differs from the first host’s, this filter will exclude all calendars for that credential, resulting in no calendar insertions (empty `map`/`Promise.all`). That matches the finding: later collective hosts on CalDAV/iCal can get no event created.
